content: Hello, may I speak to Mr. Johnson, please?
Speaking. Who's calling, may I ask?
This is the Town Job Center. We've received your e-mail and we have a job you may be interested in.
Can you tell me about it? What kind of job? Where?
Well, a college wants to hire some laboratory assistants. It's the kind of job you would like to do, according to your e-mail.
Yes, I did put that in my e-mail.
Yes. They also want a person who knows how to operate computers, so we think you are just the right person for the position.
What about the pay and the hours?
Let me check that. The pay they are offering is quite satisfactory, but the work hours are a bit irregular. Sometimes early in the morning, and sometimes late in the afternoon.
Well. I am still interested in it, but I need some more details so that I can talk it over with my wife.
Why don't you come here tomorrow?
OK, I'll do that. See you tomorrow morning then. Bye!
